name: Marsh Coachman

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The coachman makes two Bite attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Eel-Lash Lunge.

Actions.name: Bite
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +4, reach 5 ft. 6 (1d8 + 2) Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC 12). While Grappled, the target has the Restrained condition.

Actions.name: Eel-Lash Lunge
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 13, each creature in a 15-foot Cone. *Failure:* The target has the Prone condition.
Actions.clause: The coachman lurches toward a creature it can see and its coat bursts open, a dozen eels whipping out to rope the target
Actions.expresses: coils that rope and constrict prey

Bonus Actions.name: Smother
Bonus Actions.text: The coachman smothers one Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. While smothered, the target has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the coachman, and takes 3 (1d6) Bludgeoning damage at the start of each of the coachman's turns. The coachman can have only one creature smothered at a time. If the coachman takes 5 damage or more in a single turn from the smothered creature, the coachman must release the target at the end of that turn, and the target exits Prone in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of the coachman. If the coachman dies, a smothered creature pulls free Prone by using 5 feet of movement.

Traits.name: Adhesive
Traits.text: The coachman adheres to anything that touches it. A Huge or smaller creature adhered to the coachman is also Grappled by it (escape DC 12). Ability checks made to escape this grapple have Disadvantage.
Traits.gmQuote: a knot of eels in a man's coat
Traits.expresses: coils that rope and constrict prey

lore: A coachman drowned in the marsh, and the eels that fed on him now wear his coat, dragging travelers off the road to share the wet dark they came from.
